items.question: To which deity and with what concluding utterance must the teacher offer the oblation with the heart?
premises: The teacher is the agent who performs the oblation.
The oblation is directed to Soma.
The offering is made with the heart and concluded with the utterance svāhā.
items.inference: The teacher must offer the oblation to Soma with the heart, ending with the utterance svāhā.
uncertainties: Whether hṛdā refers to the hṛdaya-mantra or to the physical heart is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: And the teacher should offer an oblation to Soma with the heart, saying 'svāhā'.
